subject: Request: POC boarding delay — sandbox supplement & trial extension
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@greenleaf.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC boarding: webhook mismatch and timeline

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're blocked on the webhook schema mismatch between our ingestion pipeline and the Redwood SDK; engineering has been tied up with a major refactor and won't be able to complete the integration before our end-of-month window.

This POC is high priority internally but the current sandbox quota will run out next week. Can Redwood provide a 30-day trial extension and a sandbox token supplement (we estimate ~100k tokens) so we can finish the ingestion tests and complete the canary? I've attached the integration logs and a short note from our engineering lead.

Attachments:
- integration_log.txt (text/plain)

Appreciate any help.

—Alex
Alex Turner
Head of ML, Greenleaf Analytics
alex.turner@greenleaf.ai
+1 415-555-0132
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@greenleaf.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-28T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC boarding: webhook mismatch and timeline

Hi Alex —

Sorry to hear about the refactor timing. I can escalate on the credits/extension side but want to confirm a couple quick things so we can process this fast:

1) Can you share the mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones for the next 30 days (even a one-pager) so I can tie the extension to measurable progress?
2) Confirm whether 100k tokens is a hard estimate or a conservative ceiling.

I've looped in our commercial lead Ben Carter to review credits. I'll follow up by EOD after we sync internally.

Best,
Laura

Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
[Attachment referenced: mutual_action_plan.xlsx]
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-29T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: POC boarding: webhook mismatch and timeline — request for extension/credits

FYI — forwarding Greenleaf's note. They hit an unexpected refactor and are asking for a 30-day trial extension + ~100k token sandbox supplement to finish ingestion tests. They attached integration logs.

Short ask: can we approve a 30-day extension and up to 75k token sandbox supplement from our discretionary pool? If we can only do 75k I need a clear line to propose that back to the customer quickly.

Why this matters: Greenleaf is a mid-size data platform with clear expansion signals (they asked about Dedicated early in the demo). Granting a small runway keeps them moving to a paid evaluation.

Quoted original:
> From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@greenleaf.ai>
> ... (see attached integration_log.txt)

Can you confirm?

Thanks,
Laura
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-29T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: POC boarding: webhook mismatch and timeline — request for extension/credits

Laura — approve 30-day trial extension and 75k token sandbox credit from the discretionary fund. Please note:

- Approve only if MAP has at least 3 milestones (ingestion smoke, canary run, result review) with owner names and dates.
- Communicate that any additional top-up will require CSM approval and must be justified with telemetry (token burn per milestone).
- I'll mark this on the HubSpot deal (DL-8421) and drop a note for finance.

Marcus — can you and your team watch for the spike on the sandbox so we can auto-rotate limits if needed? 

-Ben

Ben Carter
Head of Commercial, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@greenleaf.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-30T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC boarding: webhook mismatch and timeline

Hi Alex —

Good news: we've approved a 30-day extension and a 75k token sandbox supplement to help you finish the integration while you complete the refactor. A couple of operational notes:

- We'll enable the extension today; your new trial expiry will be 2027-07-30.
- Sandbox credit: 75,000 tokens applied immediately. If you anticipate going beyond that, please share an updated MAP and token burn forecast and we'll review.
- I'll upload the MAP to the HubSpot deal and share the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cMAP

Next step: can we set up a 30-minute sync with your engineering lead and our platform engineer (Marcus) tomorrow at 10am PT to unblock the webhook mapping? If that works, I'll send an invite.

Thanks — let me know and we'll get you unstuck.

Best,
Laura
